newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telefonica del Peru ADS upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telefonica del Peru ADS upped.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co said on Wednesday it had raised its estimate of 1996 earnings per American Depositary Share (ADS) for Telefonica del Peru SA to $1.50 from $1.40.
-- In an analysis, Oppenheimer also said it was raising its earnings per ADS estimate for 1997 to $1.95 from $1.85.
-- "After a slow start in 1996, we project TDP will start delivering the kind of growth we envisioned back in 1995," the report said.
-- Oppenheimer repeated its outperform rating for the company and its $26 price target. The stock was off 3/8 to 22-1/8 in mid-afternoon trade.
